note: The polar outposts (docs/art/polar-outposts.md): a research station and a mining camp, buildings only, built from World's existing shapes in the polar palette. Written by art/concepts/world/outposts.mjs; do not edit by hand. Proposals pending Legal; Tools adds the schema.

research_station.name: The research station
research_station.what: a small cluster raised on posts above the snow: one long main module, two sleeping modules, a generator house with a stack, an instrument mast and a row of fuel drums, joined by a corridor and a snow ramp. Dark roofs, weathered timber walls, a few steady lit windows.

mining_camp.name: The mining camp
mining_camp.what: a headframe over a shaft, an ore bunker with a conveyor to a stockpile of dark rock, a stack of containers, three fuel tanks and a heater shed with a flue. Steel and rusted-brown containers, soot and rock; the heaps are the darkest, biggest shapes on the white.

measured_note: against the warm white at every key; against the slate at every key but night. At night everything is dark and a dark building on slate ground is dark on dark: it stands against the sky, not the ground.
